sn37.6:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
sn37.6:1.3: assaddho ca hoti, ahiriko ca hoti, anottāpī ca hoti, upanāhī ca hoti, duppañño ca hoti;
sn37.6:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
